features.title: Dashboard prompt writer (Excel and PowerPoint)
features.summary: Reads your data and your questions, then writes the prompt to paste into Copilot in Excel or PowerPoint to build an interactive dashboard. You get KPI cards with comparisons, filters, a panel per question, and follow-ups for drivers, what-if scenarios and data checks. It writes prompts only and changes nothing in your file.
steps: Select Download below and unzip the file.
Copy the folder dashboard-prompt-writer into your OneDrive skills folder.
In the Copilot pane, select Settings, then Manage plugins & skills, then Custom skills, then Refresh.
Open your workbook or deck, then type @dashboard-prompt-writer and your questions.
Paste the prompt it gives you into Copilot, then add the follow-ups one at a time.
prompts: @dashboard-prompt-writer Which stores are falling behind, and why?
@dashboard-prompt-writer Build a dashboard for my manager from this Jira export: what is late and who is overloaded?
@dashboard-prompt-writer What happens to margin if we cut prices 10%?
limits: The Excel dashboard and PowerPoint interactive slide features it writes for may still be in preview in your tenant. Ask your IT team.
Works best when the data is in Excel tables with clear headers and no merged cells.
After Copilot builds the dashboard, change one source cell and check the KPI cards move.
Tested by following the skill files on a fictional workbook, not yet in a live tenant. The full pack includes that workbook, a setup guide, Agent Builder instructions and a Word fallback prompt.
Community skill, not from Microsoft. Try it first on data with nothing sensitive in it.
